title: Nao consigo restaurar compra
body: Comprei em fevereiro de 2023, entretanto mudei de telemovel e hoje decidi voltar a instalar. Tentei restaurar a compra mas aparece-me um pop-up de que nao há nada para restaurar! Tentei aceder ao suporte mas a secção de Contact no website não funciona.
author: Luisahappy

title: Brilliant
body: I have been using way of life app for years, in fact at least for over 6 years.  This is how many days in a row I have meditated. I track other daily habits as well. However when I see that number every morning it inspires me to meditate everyday. It would break my heart if I missed a day. This is how you create a habit.
